name: forward_feedback
title: Forward a feedback mark to the owner
description: Pass a feedback mark you cannot or should not decide (a decision of the owners, a matter beyond the project, something unclear) to the owners: they get an alert and the mark waits for them. Do not act on the mark again; the owner or a person who processes feedback settles it.

reason.description: Why the owner must decide, in a few sentences; only the owners read it.

reply.description: Your answer to the marker: what happens to the mark now.

annotations.title: Forward a feedback mark to the owner
